ext_desc.message: Select text on any page — including ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini — and get a verified plain-language version with read-aloud.

overlay_warning.message: Check this text. Some facts (numbers or dates) may have been lost in simplification.

overlay_error.message: Could not reach the Clara server. Check the extension options.

opt_server_hint.message: Default is your own computer (http://localhost:8000) — the text never leaves your machine. The public demo (https://clara-demo.onrender.com) echoes text back unchanged: it has no model key.
